title: Storybound chapter
description: config/storybound/chapters/<path>.json (or data/<namespace>/storybound/chapters/) — a chapter of the dev mode story canvas: a title, its place in the list and where its nodes sit. Only the editor reads it; it changes nothing in game.

order.description: Chapters are listed by it, smallest first.

icon.description: An item id shown next to the title.

type.description: The definition type of the node, e.g. storybound:quest (the namespace may be left out).
